npcs.name: Owyn
npcs.greet: Blademaster of the Arena. I don't care where you're from or what you did before. On the sand, all I care about is whether you're still standing.

npcs.name: Agronak gro-Malog
npcs.greet: They call me the Gray Prince. The crowd loves the name. I've never been sure what it means, and nobody has ever told me.

relics.name: Journal of Lord Lovidicus
relics.desc: A nobleman's journal, its last pages written in a hand that grew stranger with each entry. One passage speaks of an orc woman and a son.

ar_first_bout: Citizens of the Imperial City! Fresh meat for the sand today: a Pit Dog with no name, no record, and no idea what's coming!
The gate grinds up. The crowd roars. Across the sand, your opponent spits and lifts a notched blade.
ar_gray_prince: My father was a lord of Cyrodiil. That's what my mother told me, before she died. Not that he was this.
A vampire. And my mother, gods, she must have been his... no. I won't say it. Every title I've won, every crowd that chanted my name, they were cheering for that.
I can't stand in that Arena and pretend any more. When we fight, champion, do not hold back. I want to go down honestly, if I go down at all.
ar_grand_champion: The Gray Prince falls to one knee on the sand. He looks up once, at the stands, and nods, as if the noise is something he finally understands.
The Gray Prince has fallen! Citizens, I give you your new Grand Champion!

quests.title: Blood on the Sand
quests.offer: I want to fight in the Arena.
quests.pitch: Everybody wants to fight in the Arena until the gate opens. Sign this, take a Pit Dog's raiment, and walk out onto the sand. Your first match is against Fennick Sallow, a brawler from the docks. Win, and you're on the roster.
quests.desc: Owyn, the Blademaster of the Imperial Arena, will put me on the Arena's roster if I win my first bout as a Pit Dog against a dockside brawler named Fennick Sallow.

objectives.text: Step out onto the Arena sand
Report to Owyn in the Bloodworks
objectives.reply: So he is. The crowd liked you. Don't let it go to your head; they like everybody who wins. Welcome to the Arena, Pit Dog.

quests.outro: I won my first bout in the Imperial Arena and joined the roster as a Pit Dog.

quests.title: The Brawler's Bout
quests.pitch: Two on one this time. The Hallon twins fight as a pair and they've never lost a doubles match. Keep your back to the wall and don't let them circle you.
quests.desc: Owyn matched me against the Hallon twins, a pair of gladiators who have never lost fighting together.

objectives.topic: The twins have lost a doubles match now.
objectives.reply: First time for everything. You're a Brawler now. The purse goes up, and so does the quality of the people trying to kill you.

quests.outro: I beat the Hallon twins and rose to the rank of Brawler.

quests.title: The Beast Match
quests.pitch: The crowd's bored of people. Today it's beasts: a pair of wolves from the Great Forest, and a senche the Elsweyr traders sold us at a scandalous price. Kill the wolves fast; save your strength for the cat.
quests.desc: Owyn has put me in a beast match against a pair of wolves and a senche tiger from Elsweyr.

objectives.topic: That cat was worth every septim.
objectives.reply: Ha! The traders will want to sell us another. Bloodletter, that's your rank now. Go and get your arm looked at.

quests.outro: I won the beast match against two wolves and a senche, and rose to the rank of Bloodletter.

quests.title: Three Against One
quests.pitch: Careful what you ask for. The Blue Team has put up three of their best against one of ours. That's you. They fight like a phalanx: shields up, spears out. Break the line and they break with it.
quests.desc: The rival Blue Team has challenged our side with three gladiators against one. Owyn put me forward.

objectives.text: Defeat the three Blue Team gladiators

objectives.topic: The Blue Team needs three new gladiators.
objectives.reply: And the Yellow Team gets bragging rights for a season. Myrmidon. You're climbing fast. People are starting to say your name in the stands.

quests.outro: I defeated three Blue Team gladiators alone and rose to the rank of Myrmidon.

quests.title: The Minotaur
quests.pitch: A minotaur, caught in the hills above the Nibenay. It killed four handlers on the way here. The odds-makers have you losing, which means the purse is very good if you don't.
quests.desc: Owyn matched me against a minotaur from the Nibenay hills that killed four of its handlers on the way to the Arena.

objectives.journal: The minotaur charged three times. The third time it didn't get up again. The stands were so loud I couldn't hear my own heart.

objectives.reply: They usually are about you, it seems. Warrior. And the Grand Champion asked who you were today. That's never happened before.

quests.outro: I killed the minotaur on the sand and rose to the rank of Warrior. The Grand Champion has started asking about me.

quests.title: Ogres of the Jerall
quests.pitch: Two ogres, bought from a caravan out of the Jerall. They're slow, they're stupid, and either one could flatten a horse. Don't stand where they can grab you.
quests.desc: Owyn put me in against two ogres from the Jerall Mountains.

objectives.reply: Gladiator. You've earned the title the hard way. Agronak wants to talk to you, privately. I'd go. He doesn't ask twice.

quests.outro: I killed two ogres in the Arena and was named Gladiator. Agronak gro-Malog, the Grand Champion, wants to speak with me.

quests.title: The Gray Prince's Blood
quests.offer: Owyn says you wanted to see me.
quests.pitch: I did. You travel. I don't; the Arena owns my days. My mother said my father was a lord of Cyrodiil, and before she died she gave me a name: Lovidicus. His estate is a ruin near the Gold Road. Go there. Find out who he was. Then come back and fight for Champion.
quests.desc: Agronak gro-Malog, the Gray Prince, asked me to visit the ruined estate of Lord Lovidicus, the noble his mother named as his father, and find out the truth about his blood.

objectives.text: Travel to the ruins of the Lovidicus estate
Deal with what has made its nest in the ruins

objectives.journal: The journal made it plain. Lord Lovidicus was a vampire, and the orc woman he kept in his household bore him a son. The Gray Prince.

objectives.topic: I found your father's journal. You should read it yourself.
objectives.reply: Give it here. ...No. No, that can't... Stay. Hear this from me, not from the gossips.

objectives.text: Win the Champion's bout against Ysabel Andronicus
objectives.journal: Ysabel Andronicus had held the Champion's place for three seasons. She fought cleanly and lost cleanly, and the crowd chanted her name as she was carried out.

objectives.topic: Ysabel's down. Agronak says he wants the final match.
objectives.reply: He told me. He looks like a man who's already decided how it ends. You're Champion now. Only the Gray Prince stands above you.

quests.outro: I learned that the Gray Prince is the son of a vampire lord, and won the Champion's bout. Agronak has asked for the final match, and asked me not to hold back.

quests.title: The Grand Champion
quests.desc: The whole Imperial City has turned out for the final bout: the Gray Prince against the challenger. Agronak asked me to fight him honestly, to the end.

objectives.text: Walk out onto the sand for the final bout
Defeat Agronak gro-Malog, the Gray Prince

objectives.reply: It is. He went down the way he wanted, with the crowd on its feet. The title is yours, Grand Champion. Wear it better than the last man who wore it alone.

quests.outro: I defeated Agronak gro-Malog in the final bout and became Grand Champion of the Imperial Arena.
